mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reduces the cost of capital and stimulates economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This effect is consistent across monetary policy cycles.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.0% signals labor market weakness, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods following UNRATE readings above 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and inflation (CPIAUCSL) determines the real rate; a falling real rate (FEDFUNDS - CPIAUCSL) signals monetary easing relative to inflation, boosting equity returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary policy easing relative to inflation
failure_condition: The real rate decline (FEDFUNDS - CPIAUCSL) fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) above 1150 thousand units indicate a strong housing market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods following HOUST readings above 1150.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust economic activity and corporate output, supporting earnings growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods following INDPRO readings above 110.0.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) below 150,000 thousand persons indicates a weakening labor market, reducing consumer spending and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods following PAYEMS readings below 150000.

mechanism_narrative: The joint rise in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, which supports corporate revenue growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS are above their 3-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening regime (FEDFUNDS above 2.5%), higher borrowing costs and reduced liquidity lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods following FEDFUNDS readings above 2.5%.
